entry.title: Bean's Satirical Journey for Perfect Coffee
entry.summary: Bean awoke to the activation of his vibe-coded application, Latte Vibes. It was meant to dispense perfection. Today's coffee tasted like raw static, a bitter assault on his senses. He checked the settings: one and a half spoons of sugar logged. This was the programmed calibration; he knew it was correct.
